The introduction of new roads may also lead to disruptions in traffic flow. This problem can be generalized into a special case of VRP, which aims to find the optimal route for a fleet of vehicles within a network of destinations. Finding solutions to this problem requires an exponential number of operations, hindering the ability of exact solvers to deal with large instances, which must therefore be tackled using heuristics, often leading to suboptimal results. Quantum-based algorithms may allow us to find exact solutions in polynomial time with high probability, offering a potential future alternative to classical solvers and in this work, we focus on the QAOA. Our novel contributions are a parameter-initialization strategy that improves the convergence probability and the integration of the subtour constraints directly into the optimization without using additional qubits by employing an approximation of exponential equality constraints. We believe that our results pave the way for effectively solving instances of VRP using quantum-based solutions, leveraging the space-efficient problem encoding and our initialization strategy, which limits the effect of barren-plateau under random parameter initialization.
zh_title: 量子车辆路径问题：一种针对病态优化景观的智能初始化策略
translation: 随着复杂交通基础设施的扩展，连接不同目的地的新路径不断涌现，使得多种路线的定义成为可能。新道路的引入也可能导致交通流量中断。这个问题可以泛化为VRP的一个特例，旨在在一个目的地网络中为一支车队找到最优路径。解决这个问题需要指数级的操作，阻碍了精确求解器处理大型实例的能力，因此必须使用启发式方法，但这通常会导致次优结果。基于量子的算法可能使我们能够以高概率在多项式时间内找到精确解，为经典求解器提供了潜在的未来替代方案，在本工作中，我们专注于QAOA。我们的新颖贡献是一种参数初始化策略，它提高了收敛概率，并通过采用指数等式约束的近似，在不使用额外量子比特的情况下将子路径约束直接整合到优化中。我们相信，我们的结果为使用基于量子的解决方案有效解决VRP实例铺平了道路，利用了空间高效的问题编码和我们的初始化策略，这限制了随机参数初始化下荒漠高原效应的影响。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的智能初始化策略，以解决车辆路径问题（VRP），旨在提高收敛概率并有效处理子路径约束。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了针对QAOA的智能参数初始化策略和高效的子路径约束集成方法，有效解决了量子优化中常见的荒漠高原问题，并提高了算法的收敛性。这对于将量子计算应用于实际的组合优化问题，特别是VRP，具有重要意义。
motivation: 车辆路径问题（VRP）在处理大规模实例时，传统精确求解器需要指数级操作，导致次优结果。量子算法有望在多项式时间内找到精确解，为经典求解器提供潜在的替代方案，因此研究量子方法解决VRP具有重要意义。
method: 本文专注于量子近似优化算法（QAOA），并提出了两个主要贡献：1) 一种参数初始化策略，旨在提高收敛概率；2) 通过近似指数等式约束，在不使用额外量子比特的情况下将子路径约束直接整合到优化中。
results: 提出的参数初始化策略改善了收敛概率，并且结合空间高效的问题编码，使得量子解决方案能有效解决VRP实例，同时限制了随机参数初始化下荒漠高原效应的影响。
conclusion: 本研究的结果为使用基于量子的解决方案有效解决VRP实例铺平了道路，通过利用空间高效的问题编码和提出的初始化策略，限制了随机参数初始化下荒漠高原效应的影响。

title: D2ML: Models for Direct-to-Biology Small Molecule Screening
authors: AkshatKumar Nigam, Neri Amara, Hillary Dequina, Dyana Kenanova, Seth Malmersjo, Fiorella Ruggiu, Raymond V. Fucini, Jack Sadowsky, Stig K. Hansen, Imran S. Haque
abstract: Direct-to-biology (D2B) screening enables rapid testing of newly synthesized molecules without purification. However, uncertain concentrations in crude mixtures and limited purified-compound measurements complicate the use of these data in machine learning. Here we show that models tailored to the structure of D2B data can improve prediction and guide the discovery of more potent and selective compounds. Our assay-aware models predict activity from single-point screens, relative potency across targets from crude dose-response assays, and absolute potency from purified-compound measurements. For crude assays, potency ratios between targets tested from the same well can retain selectivity information despite uncertain concentrations. A joint model that shares information across stages and balances their contributions to training improved predictions over separate neural networks. The largest gain was in crude dose-response selectivity prediction, where rank correlation increased from 0.27 to 0.40. In a separate experiment, independently trained models guided the selection of 84 new compounds to improve ROS1 potency while limiting activity against the anti-target TRKB. Synthesis and testing identified compounds that extended the measured Pareto front, achieving better combinations of potency and selectivity than those in the training data. The most selective new compound achieved a ROS1 IC50 of 14.7 nM and 233-fold selectivity over TRKB. By comparison, the most selective training compound had a ROS1 IC50 of 20.3 nM and 79-fold selectivity. ATLAS provides the experimental setting for this approach, supporting synthesis and screening of 1,000-10,000 model-selected compounds in two- to three-week cycles. Together, these results show how assay-aware learning can use the full D2B assay sequence to guide multi-objective molecular optimization.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD)
zh_title: D2ML：用于直接生物学小分子筛选的模型
translation: 直接生物学（D2B）筛选可以在不进行纯化的情况下快速测试新合成的分子。然而，粗混合物中不确定的浓度和有限的纯化化合物测量使得这些数据难以用于机器学习。本文展示了专门针对D2B数据结构定制的模型可以改进预测并指导发现更有效和选择性的化合物。我们的检测感知模型（assay-aware models）从单点筛选中预测活性，从粗剂量反应检测中预测靶点间的相对效力，并从纯化化合物测量中预测绝对效力。对于粗检测，来自同一孔的靶点间的效力比可以在不确定浓度下保留选择性信息。一个在不同阶段共享信息并平衡其贡献的联合模型在训练中改进了预测，优于单独的神经网络。最大的增益体现在粗剂量反应选择性预测上，秩相关性从0.27提高到0.40。在另一项实验中，独立训练的模型指导了84种新化合物的选择，以提高ROS1效力并限制对反靶点TRKB的活性。合成和测试确定了扩展测量帕累托前沿的化合物，实现了比训练数据中更好的效力和选择性组合。最具选择性的新化合物的ROS1 IC50为14.7 nM，对TRKB的选择性是233倍。相比之下，最具选择性的训练化合物的ROS1 IC50为20.3 nM，选择性是79倍。ATLAS为这种方法提供了实验环境，支持在两到三周的周期内合成和筛选1,000-10,000个模型选择的化合物。总而言之，这些结果展示了检测感知学习如何利用完整的D2B检测序列来指导多目标分子优化。
tldr: D2ML开发了针对直接生物学（D2B）筛选数据定制的机器学习模型，通过整合不同阶段的检测信息，显著提高了活性和选择性化合物的预测与发现能力。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其“检测感知”和“联合模型”的方法，有效地解决了直接生物学（D2B）筛选数据中因浓度不确定性导致的复杂性，从而使机器学习能够更有效地利用这些数据。这种方法不仅提高了预测准确性，还成功指导了具有更高效力和选择性的新化合物的发现，尤其在药物发现领域具有重要的应用价值。通过在不同筛选阶段共享信息，最大化了有限数据的利用效率。
motivation: 直接生物学（D2B）筛选允许快速测试未经纯化的新合成分子，但粗混合物中不确定的浓度和有限的纯化化合物测量使得这些数据难以用于机器学习。因此，需要开发能够有效利用D2B数据的模型来改进预测并指导更有效和选择性化合物的发现。
method: 该研究开发了针对D2B数据结构量身定制的检测感知模型（assay-aware models）。这些模型能够从单点筛选中预测活性，从粗剂量反应检测中预测靶点间的相对效力，并从纯化化合物测量中预测绝对效力。通过一个在不同阶段共享信息并平衡其贡献的联合模型（joint model），在训练中优于单独的神经网络。特别是，利用了来自同一孔的靶点间效力比可以在不确定浓度下保留选择性信息。
results: 联合模型改进了预测，其中在粗剂量反应选择性预测方面增益最大，秩相关性从0.27提高到0.40。独立训练的模型成功指导了84种新化合物的选择，以提高ROS1效力并限制对TRKB的活性。合成和测试结果表明，新发现的化合物扩展了测量到的帕累托前沿，实现了比训练数据中更好的效力和选择性组合。最选择性的新化合物的ROS1 IC50为14.7 nM，对TRKB的选择性是233倍，而训练数据中最选择性的化合物ROS1 IC50为20.3 nM，选择性是79倍。ATLAS提供了这种方法所需的实验环境，支持在两到三周的周期内合成和筛选1,000-10,000个模型选择的化合物。
conclusion: 检测感知学习能够利用完整的D2B检测序列来指导多目标分子优化，从而发现具有改进效力和选择性的新化合物。

title: Stochastic and Noisy Oracles in Smooth Continuous Optimization
authors: Albert S. Berahas, Liyuan Cao, Katya Scheinberg
abstract: We review models of inexact computational oracles in smooth continuous optimization and their implications for the convergence, computational complexity, and attainable accuracy of optimization algorithms. We adopt a framework in which zeroth-,first-, and second-order oracles are characterized by quantitative error bounds and may accept additional control parameters that influence both their accuracy and computational cost. We introduce deterministic and stochastic oracle models and illustrate their properties through a variety of examples, including finite-difference approximations, stochastic gradients, and randomized derivative estimators. Particular attention is given to the distinction between absolute and relative errors, bias and variance, and stochastic function evaluations with independent or coupled randomness. A central theme of the review is the use of common analytical tools to recover and compare convergence and complexity guarantees under different oracle models. For deterministic and stochastic first-order methods, we show how a general descent inequality leads to complexity bounds under various assumptions on the objective function and all proposed oracle models. In the stochastic setting, we develop bounds on expected stopping times and the accuracy that can be guaranteed under different oracle conditions. We also examine the total computational complexity of algorithms relying on specific oracle constructions and briefly review models of inexact second- order information and their use in optimization algorithms.
zh_title: 平滑连续优化中的随机与噪声神谕模型
translation: 我们回顾了平滑连续优化中不精确计算神谕（oracles）的模型及其对优化算法收敛性、计算复杂度和可达精度的影响。我们采用了一个框架，其中零阶、一阶和二阶神谕由定量误差界限表征，并可能接受影响其精度和计算成本的额外控制参数。我们引入了确定性和随机神谕模型，并通过各种示例说明了它们的属性，包括有限差分近似、随机梯度和随机导数估计器。特别关注了绝对误差与相对误差、偏差与方差、以及具有独立或耦合随机性的随机函数评估之间的区别。该综述的一个中心主题是使用共同的分析工具来恢复和比较不同神谕模型下的收敛性和复杂度保证。对于确定性和随机一阶方法，我们展示了在目标函数和所有提出的神谕模型的各种假设下，通用的下降不等式如何推导出复杂度界限。在随机设置中，我们开发了在不同神谕条件下可以保证的期望停止时间和精度的界限。我们还检查了依赖于特定神谕构造的算法的总计算复杂度，并简要回顾了不精确二阶信息模型及其在优化算法中的应用。
tldr: 本文综述了平滑连续优化中的不精确神谕模型，利用统一分析框架探讨了确定性与随机性算法在不同误差、偏差和方差条件下的收敛性与计算复杂度。
ai_comments: 该综述系统地梳理了平滑连续优化中各种不精确计算神谕（Oracles）模型，统一了确定性和随机性一阶、二阶方法的收敛性与复杂度分析框架，对于理解现代随机优化算法的理论基础具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 旨在综述平滑连续优化中不精确计算神谕模型，探讨其对优化算法的收敛性、计算复杂度和可达到精度的影响，并利用通用分析工具在不同神谕模型下恢复和比较收敛与复杂度保证。
method: 采用统一的分析框架，重点考察由定量误差界表征的零阶、一阶和二阶神谕模型；通过通用的下降不等式推导不同神谕模型下的复杂度界，并研究随机设置下的期望停时与精度保证。
results: 展示了通用下降不等式如何针对目标函数的各种假设以及提出的神谕模型推导复杂度界，建立了随机设置下关于期望停时和可保证精度的界限，并考察了依赖特定神谕构造的算法的总计算复杂度。
conclusion: 本文通过统一的分析框架和通用的下降不等式，成功对比并恢复了不同神谕模型下的收敛率与复杂度保证，为深入理解确定性和随机连续优化提供了系统的理论视角。

title: Quantum query complexity of Hurwitz stability testing
authors: Maxwell Fitzsimmons, Mohamed Serry, Meenu Kumari, Jun Liu
abstract: Determining whether every trajectory of the linear system $\dot{x}=Ax$ converges to zero (or, equivalently, whether $A$ is Hurwitz stable) is a fundamental problem in control theory. It arises, for example, in verifying the stability of feedback controllers and state observers, as well as of linearized dynamical models. We study the quantum query complexity of deciding whether a matrix $A\in\mathbb{C}^{n\times n}$ is Hurwitz stable, given an exact normalized block-encoding of $A$. The query complexity is characterized in terms of the system dimension $n$ and a supplied lower bound $0<ν\leq ω_A$ on the imaginary-axis distance $ω_A:=\min_{t\in\mathbb{R}}σ_{\min}(A-\mathrm{i}tI)$, where $σ_{\min}(A)$ is the smallest singular value of $A$. We prove a query-complexity lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{n}/ν)$, which holds even when $A$ is restricted to be real and diagonal. For general matrices with nonzero $ω_A$, we encode an approximation of the right-half-plane spectral projector $\operatorname{sign}^+(A):=(I+\operatorname{sign}(A))/2$ as a block of a matrix inverse, where $A$ is Hurwitz if and only if the projector is zero. To test this, we produce a quantum algorithm which determines if a $(β,b,1/(4\sqrt{n}))$-block-encoded projector matrix (like $\operatorname{sign}^+(A)$) is zero or not; for constant success probability, it has complexity $Θ(β\sqrt{n})$. When the zero test is applied to specific approximations of $\operatorname{sign}^+(A)$, this yields an upper bound of $O(\sqrt{n}ν^{-2}\log(\sqrt{n}/ν))$ queries in the general case, and $O(\sqrt{n}ν^{-1}\log n)$ when $A$ is Hermitian or normal. The latter upper bound matches the lower bound up to a logarithmic factor. Thus the dimension dependence of quantum Hurwitz testing is nearly optimal, while the remaining factor in the non-normal case isolates an open conditioning gap.

title: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification on Simplicial Complexes with Conformalized Simplicial Neural Networks
authors: Lekun Wang, Jaidev Goel, Yulia R. Gel, Yao Xie
abstract: Simplicial neural networks (SNNs) are powerful tools for prediction tasks on higher-order relational datasets stored on simplicial complexes (SCs), a higher-order generalization of graphs. However, SNNs usually lack rigorous uncertainty quantification (UQ), limiting their usefulness in high-stakes scenarios. We propose conformalized SNN (CF-SNN), a framework that, given a simplicial-complex entity with m prediction targets, generates prediction sets for all m targets simultaneously. Under mild assumptions, CF-SNN guarantees that, for each target, the prediction set contains the true label with a user-specified nominal coverage probability, and the realized miscoverage proportion across all m targets is guaranteed to remain close to the nominal level with high probability. Extensive experiments across a wide range of SC prediction tasks demonstrate that CF-SNN is a flexible UQ framework that achieves user-specified coverage while producing informative prediction sets of small size.

title: Understanding LLM-Based Bargaining of Driving Agents in Mixed-Autonomy Traffic
authors: Lingxiao Zhou, Di Chen, Jia Li
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a flexible computational approach for modeling social interactions among heterogeneous agents. This paper develops a novel framework towards characterizing and understanding LLM-based population-level bargaining of shared road space between autonomous vehicle (AV) and human-driven vehicle (HV) agents in mixed-autonomy traffic. Through controlled experiments varying traffic density, agent objectives, and traffic-domain knowledge, we first characterize bargaining outcomes and observe heterogeneous agreement rates across different experimental conditions. To understand how the bargaining process shapes the outcomes, we introduce a behavioral taxonomy that jointly characterizes numerical bidding actions and communicative attitudes. We examine two complementary aspects of social interaction: inter-agent bargaining dynamics and private-to-public behavioral transformation. Results reveal distinct interaction patterns associated with agreement and breakdown, including greater constructive reciprocity in agreement trials and more frequent conflict escalation in breakdown trials. Furthermore, private and public communicative attitudes often differ even when numerical bids remain unchanged. These findings illustrate how LLM-based bargaining simulations can support a structured analysis of social interaction behaviors in mixed-autonomy traffic.

title: PBSR: Pseudo-Burst Super-Resolution via Zero-Shot Novel View Synthesis
authors: Yuki Kondo, Norimichi Ukita
abstract: Burst super-resolution (BSR) achieves higher reconstruction fidelity than single-image super-resolution (SISR) by aggregating sub-pixel information from multiple frames. However, it requires a burst of frames captured under near-static conditions, and such frames are unavailable for single photographs or archival images. We propose Pseudo-Burst Super-Resolution (PBSR), which brings BSR-style reconstruction to the single-image input setting by synthesizing pseudo-burst frames via zero-shot novel view synthesis (NVS). PBSR first generates pseudo-burst frames with realistic parallax using a viewpoint sampling strategy calibrated to the pixel-shift distribution of real burst datasets. The frames are then processed by a BSR backbone equipped with a geometry-aware alignment module that reuses the NVS camera parameters and estimated depth. While the NVS stage is zero-shot, the backbone is fine-tuned with an artifact-aware adaptation so that it can exploit the synthesized frames despite their generative artifacts. Experiments on the BurstSR dataset show that PBSR consistently improves in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS over the single-frame baseline with the same reconstruction backbone.
comment: Accepted for publication in New Generation Computing. 17 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables

title: DistFlow and Its Conic Relaxation: Regularity, Monotonicity, and Hybrid Exactness via Graph Decomposition
authors: Xinliang Dai
abstract: Classical exactness conditions for conic relaxations of the DistFlow model rely, among other assumptions, either on all nodal injections being adjustable or on a network-wide path condition. In practice, these conditions may not hold uniformly across a feeder: controllable distributed energy resources (DERs) sit at some buses and fixed loads at others, while reverse flows from DER-rich regions can violate the path condition. This paper certifies exactness region by region and composes the regional certificates, accounting for perturbations that propagate downstream through voltages. We first introduce a subtree voltage stability region, in which the network and all compatible subtrees remain regular. Within it, two endpoint sign conditions, one relaxing the nonnegative-flow assumption and one implied by the classical path condition, yield monotone responses of voltages, currents, and losses to root voltages. Using duality, the implicit function theorem, and sign properties of inverse sensitivity matrices, we recast both classical arguments as individual sign certificates on branch multipliers. This turns exactness into a branchwise property that can be certified region by region. A partition rule then splits the network into dispatchable and passive subtrees, and a hybrid certificate combines their local conditions into exactness of the full-network relaxation, under additional operating-limit and objective conditions. In particular, placing controllable DERs at both ends of a branch with large reverse flow exempts that branch from the passive sign conditions.

title: Coarse-Graining Optimal Transport for Rollout-Free Post-Training of Flow Matching
authors: Soon Hoe Lim, Aditi Gupta, Michael W. Mahoney, N. Benjamin Erichson
abstract: Flow matching depends critically on the coupling used to pair source and target samples. Optimal transport (OT) couplings can reduce velocity conflict and straighten trajectories; but, in practice, challenges remain: the source comes from a continuous distribution, only a finite number of target samples data are accessible, and the neural network has finite capacity. For these reasons, making the coupling more OT-like may not consistently improve sampling quality, in particular in the low number-of-function-evaluation (NFE) regime. Motivated by this, we introduce ReCouple, a controllable framework that constructs coarse-grained OT couplings, to better understand rollout-free OT-based post-training. We also consider extensions of this basic framework: ReCouple+ extends this toward the continuous-source setting by increasing source resolution, converging to semi-discrete OT in the appropriate limit; and ReCouple++ further adds spatial regularization, motivated by the observation that straight trajectories need not correspond to spatially simple velocity fields. Empirical validation demonstrates the effectiveness of these methods, and it reveals an NFE-dependent interplay between coupling optimality, neural realizability, and generation quality.

title: Estimation of Quantum Umlaut Information
authors: Beomjoon Kim, Donghwa Ji, Kabgyun Jeong
abstract: Quantifying correlations is important for understanding how quantum states and channels support information processing. Quantum umlaut information $U$ connects such correlations to reliability in hypothesis testing and certain communication settings, but its known formulas require classical descriptions of the underlying states. To estimate correlations without these descriptions, we introduce measured quantum umlaut information $U^M$ by replacing Umegaki relative entropy with measured relative entropy. Its variational formulation leads to a quantum generative adversarial framework for estimating $U^M$ from measurement statistics of unknown bipartite states and classical-quantum channels. This framework optimizes reference states and measurements without reconstructing the target states or channel outputs. For classical-quantum channels, it also optimizes the input probabilities. We further analyze the relation between $U^M$ and $U$, deriving a state-dependent gap bound and characterizing equality for full-rank bipartite states. Numerical simulations show trained estimates close on average to independently computed numerical references for $U^M$ across the tested states and channels. These estimates could help assess how well quantum memories preserve correlations and how noise or drift affects input-output dependence in quantum transmitters and state-preparation devices.

title: Truthful and Admissible Principal--Agent Testing with Nuisance Parameters
authors: Aaditya Ramdas
abstract: Statistical contracts reward experimenters according to the evidence produced by a costly study, so the reward rule influences both who participates and what they report. Principal--agent testing theory explains how to prevent ineffective proposals from being profitable. We ask when such contracts can also elicit honest parameter reports if the decision concerns a mean effect but the variance or distributional shape is unknown. Under risk neutrality and a fixed participation cost, we construct menus of e-values --- nonnegative normalized rewards with expected value at most one under every null --- such that (i) agents who know they are null have no incentive to participate, (ii) every alternative type earns positive expected profit and is thus incentivized to participate, (iii) truthful reporting uniquely maximizes expected their reward, (iv) and each contract is admissible: its payouts cannot be pointwise improved while retaining null validity. For Gaussian observations, we treat separately agents who know both mean and variance and agents who know only their mean; in the latter case, truthfulness holds at every variance without requiring a nuisance prior. Multi-sample extensions preserve these incentives and can reward accumulating evidence. Beyond Gaussian models, we show that two independent nonnegative observations suffice to elicit any finite mean above a positive null threshold, without any further distributional knowledge, but one observation cannot combine strict mean elicitation with individual admissibility on this class. Finally, we distinguish the existence of useful tests from the identification needed for truthful contracts. Boundedness is not required, and finitely many null constraints do not by themselves guarantee admissible elicitation.

title: ART of PIV: Agentic Real-Time Particle Image Velocimetry for Active Flow Control
authors: Antonio Terpin, Francesco Banelli, Alan Bonomi, Raffaello D'Andrea
abstract: Particle image velocimetry (PIV) measures fluid motion from images of tracer particles, but its accuracy depends on choices throughout the estimation pipeline, including image preprocessing, flow estimation, and postprocessing. These choices are typically left to expert tuning, and a fixed configuration can become less accurate as conditions change. This matters especially when PIV supplies feedback for real-time control, where measurements must be both accurate and fast, and flow conditions vary. We introduce ART of PIV -- short for Agentic Real-Time and also a nod to the art of tuning a PIV pipeline -- which automates pipeline choice for each image pair. A learned agent selects a configuration according to a chosen measurement objective from a library assembled for a specified speed budget. Across cross-correlation, classical optical-flow, and learning-based estimators, ART of PIV reduces average end-point error (AEPE) by 12.2-22.4 % relative to the best single estimator at matched speed, with gains extending to 1000-4000 image pair/s. In a simulated local velocity regulation task, it reduces mean normalized closed-loop cost by 13.24-13.59 percentage points relative to a tuned fixed estimator, with the same classical controller in both cases. In a tabletop water channel, we illustrate two ways to tune ART of PIV for a fluidic pinball of three rotating cylinders: selecting between complementary optical-flow tunings for accuracy, and selecting regions of interest with coherent rotation or shear using a common flow estimator. For the first variant, we train a DreamerV3 reinforcement learning controller directly in the physical world and demonstrate tracking of a prescribed flow field in the wake of a fluidic pinball.

title: Sparse descent subspace-Newton thresholding algorithm for sparse optimization problems
authors: Zhong-Feng Sun, Nan Meng, Yun-Bin Zhao
abstract: In this paper, we propose a sparse descent direction derived from the Newton direction within a low-dimensional subspace for sparse optimization problems. Building upon this direction and incorporating hard thresholding and orthogonal projection, we develop a novel algorithm termed the sparse descent subspace-Newton thresholding (SDSNT) algorithm. We further establish its global convergence under the restricted isometry property $δ_{3k}\leq \sqrt{3/20}$ of the measurement matrix. Numerical experiments on random sparse vector recovery and audio signal reconstruction reveal that SDSNT achieves comparable performance to several state-of-the-art algorithms. Notably, relative to most of them, it delivers superior recovery at high sparsity levels and improved efficiency at low sparsity levels.

title: Feature-preserving interface reconstruction using piecewise circles and cusps
authors: Jerry Liu, Kenneth Weiss, Jin Yao
abstract: We present a geometric interface reconstruction method for Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) simulations that captures both curved interfaces and sharp features using only volume fraction data. We represent interfaces with linear facets, circular arcs, and corner facets formed by two lines or arcs joined within a single cell. We first propagate local orientation constraints through a graph and merge cells to resolve ambiguities, treating topological consistency as a first-class constraint. An optional conservative refinement improves $C^0$ continuity while preserving local volume constraints. Users can independently enable circular facets, corner facets, cell merging, and continuity refinement to balance accuracy and computational cost. In its simplest configuration, our method provides a fast local line-fitting scheme competitive with state-of-the-art PLIC methods. On standard static benchmarks, the full configuration reconstructs identifiable lines, circles, and sufficiently resolved corners to numerical precision on coarse, perturbed Cartesian meshes. On varying-curvature interfaces, it achieves third-order convergence in facet-gap error and approximately first-order convergence in curvature error. These results demonstrate global volume conservation and accurate reconstruction of curved and corner features.
comment: 55 pages, 30 figures. Code and benchmark data: https://github.com/jerrywliu/interface-reconstruction/releases/tag/jcp-submission-2026-10-22-r1

title: Bayesian PET Reconstruction with Learned Flow Matching Priors via Langevin Sampling
authors: Hengjia Ran, Huafeng Liu, Bo Zhao
abstract: Image reconstruction for positron emission tomography (PET) is a challenging inverse problem due to its inherent ill-posedness and Poisson counting noise, particularly in low-dose acquisitions. In this work, we introduce a novel Bayesian PET reconstruction framework that leverages a flow-matching generative prior learned from high-quality PET images. By incorporating this prior, we formulate PET reconstruction as a Bayesian inference problem and solve it via latent-space posterior sampling using the unadjusted Langevin algorithm. We evaluate the proposed method through numerical experiments and benchmark it against classical reconstruction methods and state-of-the-art deep learning-based baselines. The proposed method achieves improved reconstruction performance while enabling posterior uncertainty quantification.
comment: Selected as the Best Student Paper Award for 2026 IVMSP

title: With foundation-model features, aggregator complexity does not improve cross-hospital discrimination in gastric whole-slide image classification
authors: Nheng Vanchhay, Ali Hussain, Khan Ziaullah, Moon-Il Joo, Md Ariful Islam Mozumder, Rashedul Islam Sumon, Won-Ae Lee, Min-Sun Cho, Hyeong-Chan Shin, Yujun Park, Baek Hwan Cho, Nam-Hoon Cho, Heejung An, Heung-Kook Choi, Haeyoun Kang, Hyunki Kim, Hee Cheol Kim
abstract: Whole-slide image classifiers are usually developed within one hospital and often go untested at unseen hospitals. We assembled 5,036 haematoxylin-and-eosin-stained gastric slides from five Korean hospitals, scanned at 20x and 40x, and compared multiple-instance learning aggregators under leave-one-hospital-out validation on frozen pathology foundation-model features. A hierarchical patch-region-slide graph aggregator (CHIME-MIL) with site alignment and two-scale fusion reached a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.837, above six conventional attention and transformer aggregators trained without these steps. Under a matched recipe it did not exceed attention-based pooling, and global max pooling given the same alignment and fusion was better (AUC 0.855, P = 0.0002). The alignment, which subtracts each hospital's mean feature vector without labels, onboarded a new hospital from ten unlabelled slides and cost 0.002 AUC without held-out-hospital data, but its accuracy gains were small and inconsistent. The model had low top-label calibration error (0.053) but under-confident malignancy probabilities, and removing its most-attended patches lowered the malignancy probability far more than removing random patches. With these features, more complex aggregators did not improve discrimination; what a deployable system adds is label-free onboarding, calibration checks and auditable evidence.

title: PRIN: A Perceptual-Structural Retinex-Inspired Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement
authors: Qiyi Xie, Wei Chen Ng, Ziyao Li, Yuning Wu, Huasen Wu, Tianshi Miao, Jian Ding Tan
abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) focuses not only on visibility recovery but also on preserving structurally meaningful content and perceptual naturalness. Existing learning-based methods may achieve favorable pixel-wise fidelity while still producing over-smoothed textures, color deviations, or spatially incoherent illumination. Retinex-inspired methods provide interpretable decomposition into reflectance and illumination components, however, the asymmetric restoration roles of these components are rarely encoded through branch-specific frequency-domain refinement. To address this issue, we propose a Perceptual-Structural Retinex-Inspired Network (PRIN), which integrates Retinex priors with restoration-role-aware enhancement. PRIN employs a shared encoder and asymmetric decoders to estimate reflectance and illumination components. The reflectance branch performs attention-guided and edge-aware wavelet refinement to preserve textures and boundaries, whereas the illumination branch promotes spatially coherent brightness adjustment. After the recomposition of reflectance and illumination branches, a curve-based post-composition enhancement head calibrates residual tone and exposure deviations. Experiments on LOL-v1, LOL-v2-Syn, and LOL-v2-Real show that the proposed network ties for the best structural similarity index (SSIM) and obtains the second-lowest learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) on LOL-v1, achieves the best SSIM and LPIPS on LOL-v2-Syn, and obtains the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and the second-lowest LPIPS on LOL-v2-Real.

title: Pinching Antennas for ISAC: Waveguide Architectures, Solutions, and Future Directions
authors: Qian Gao, Ruikang Zhong
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a core design principle for sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, yet fixed antenna geometry limits its performance. Pinching antenna systems (PASS) guide electromagnetic waves along dielectric waveguides and radiate them through position-adaptive antennas, allowing communication links and sensing observations to benefit from spatial reconfiguration. This article reviews PASS-enabled ISAC through single-waveguide, multi-waveguide, and segmented-waveguide architectures, comparing their feed structures, spatial degrees of freedom, operating protocols, and uplink/downlink support. We organize solution pathways around physics-consistent modeling, joint spatial-signal optimization, dynamic channel acquisition, and stable real-time control. A segmented waveguide-enabled pinching-antenna array (SWAN) case study demonstrates joint segment selection, antenna po?sitioning, and transmit beamforming using segment-hysteresis reinforcement learning. The results illustrate how waveguide loss and per-segment aperture gain create communication-sensing tradeoffs. We conclude with research directions in joint transmit?receive operation, measurement-calibrated digital twins, and trustworthy control.

title: The lattice of antichains of intervals: Dyck paths, level sets, and sweep dimension
authors: Paolo Boldi, Sebastiano Vigna
abstract: The Clarke-Cormack-Burkowski lattice $\mathcal{E}_n$ is the lattice of antichains of intervals of the chain $\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$, the algebraic structure underlying minimal-interval semantics, a query semantics used in information retrieval. We give an explicit, elementary anti-isomorphism between $\mathcal{E}_n$ minus its top element and the Stanley lattice of Dyck words of semilength $n+1$ (an anti-isomorphism whose existence is implicit in work of Ferrari and Munarini), under which the rank of an antichain is $\binom{n+1}{2}$ minus the area of the associated Dyck word. Hence the rank generating function of $\mathcal{E}_n\setminus\{\top\}$ is the reverse of the Carlitz-Riordan $q$-Catalan polynomial. Using a local limit theorem for the area of random-walk excursions, we confirm unconditionally an asymptotic formula of Takács: the size $λ_n$ of the largest level set of $\mathcal{E}_n$ satisfies $λ_n\simκ\,4^{n+1}/(n+1)^3$, where $κ\approx1.0807$. Finally, for the antichains of intervals of an arbitrary finite poset $P$ we study the sweep dimension, the minimum number of linear orders needed to separate every interval from every element outside it. It equals the Dushnik-Miller dimension of the lattice of convex subsets of $P$, it is the least $k$ for which $P$ maps into $\mathbb{R}^k$ so that every interval is the preimage of an upper orthant, and it lies between $\max(2,w)$ and $2w$, where $w$ is the width of $P$, both bounds being tight. Antichains of intervals embed, preserving joins, into $k$-dimensional staircase regions.

title: Distilling Knowledge from Search: Decoder Model Factory for Quantum LDPC Codes
authors: Anil Bilgin, Wanda Hou, Pranav Srinivas, Yi-Zhuang You
abstract: We introduce GraphMP, a learning-based message-passing decoder for quantum low-density parity-check codes that transfers without fine-tuning across code families, code sizes, physical error rates, and noise models. GraphMP uses local message passing to keep computation scalable as the decoding graph grows. Guided by its predictions, beam search progressively refines candidate error patterns, trading additional decoding time for lower logical error rates. We develop the decoder model factory as a paradigm for training successive models on experience generated by earlier models during decoding. Model-guided search supplies verified trajectories for knowledge distillation, folding computation spent on decoding into reusable training data. Repeated collection and distillation improve the decoder across generations and adapt its strategy as the noise changes. These results motivate a coupled quantum--classical architecture with two interacting cycles: rapid decoding protects quantum information, while slower learning renews the models from operating experience. The long-term vision is a scalable decoder model factory that produces high-performance, low-latency decoders and continually adapts them to evolving quantum hardware.

title: On $t$-designs supported by self-orthogonal codes
authors: Masaaki Harada
abstract: We study self-orthogonal $t$-$(v,k,λ)$ designs satisfying the condition that the codes generated by the designs are self-orthogonal codes whose codewords of minimum weight $k$ correspond to the blocks. A classification of such designs is given under the conditions that $t\geq \lfloor k/4\rfloor+1\geq2$ and $t \le 11$. This yields a classification of self-orthogonal codes of minimum weight $k$ whose codewords of minimum weight form a $t$-design under the same conditions.

title: Conditional Neural SDEs for Financial Time-Series Generation
authors: Sina Molavipour, Alireza M. Javid, Björn Löfdahl, Mikhail Nechaev
abstract: Conditional generation of time-series paths is a central problem in probabilistic modeling, where the goal is to simulate future trajectories that are both realistic and responsive to external context. It has direct applications in finance and economics. Neural stochastic differential equations provide a natural framework for this task by combining continuous-time stochastic dynamics with learnable drift and diffusion functions. However, directly modeling the target state can be unstable in conditional settings, especially when the target and conditioning variables have strong level dependence, limited training data, or different dimensions.We propose a residualanchor Neural SDE architecture that decomposes the target into a learned conditional anchor and a stochastic residual. The anchor captures the context-dependent baseline, while the Neural SDE (Stochastic Differential Equation) models the residual dynamics around this baseline. This separation reduces the burden on the stochastic dynamics and generalizes spread-based representations to more general conditioning settings.We evaluate the approach on real-world financial time series, including conditional interest-rate scenarios and a comparison with a time-series foundation model. The results show that the proposed model can generate plausible conditional paths, maintain competitive point accuracy, and provide calibrated uncertainty estimates.

title: GNSS Receiver Operating Point Comparison Between Vector and Scalar Tracking Under High-Dynamics
authors: J. Fermín Llorente, Ernesto M. López, Javier A. Smidt, Pedro A. Roncagliolo
abstract: This paper presents a measurement noise adaptation mechanism for Kalman filter-based carrier tracking in a navigation-aided GNSS receiver designed for launch-vehicle applications. The tracking loop is tuned for 20\,g acceleration steps, which requires a wide bandwidth that makes the loop vulnerable to noise-driven pull-out at low carrier-to-noise density ratios. To resolve this tradeoff, the measurement noise covariance, $R$, is inflated via a two-layer gate: a sigmoid envelope keyed to the signal $C/N_0$, modulated by a dynamics indicator derived from the discriminator output statistics of the Loop Bandwidth Control Algorithm. During noise-dominated periods the gate inflates~$R$, reducing the Kalman gain so the filter coasts on the navigation-aided prediction; when dynamics are detected the gate opens within one epoch, restoring the high-bandwidth tuning. The navigation aiding is formulated as a stochastic control input whose uncertainty is propagated from the navigation EKF covariance. Simulation results on a 20\,g acceleration step scenario show that the adapted vector architecture doubles the lock-retention rate relative to the standalone scalar filter at $C/N_0 = 31$\,dB-Hz. The receiver is implemented in MSGR, an open-source MATLAB GNSS software-defined receiver.

title: Distributed Grid Search for Hyperparameter Tuning
authors: Constança De Herdeiro Cachim, Andrea Martin, Nicola Bastianello
abstract: The performance of many distributed optimization algorithms over peer-to-peer networks strongly depends on the choice of their hyperparameters. However, existing selection rules often require global quantities, yield conservative choices, or are tied to specific algorithms and hyperparameters. We propose Distributed Grid Search (D-GS), a consensus-based search method that evaluates and selects hyperparameter configurations across the network, requiring only the ability to run the tuned algorithm and evaluate local gradients. We also propose a zoom-in variant, Distributed Zoom Grid Search (D-ZGS), which improves empirical performance at a reduced cost. We prove that both methods terminate in finite time with all agents holding the same hyperparameter configuration, and quantify the (sub)optimality of this configuration. Numerical experiments on linear and logistic regression show that D-GS closely matches a centralized reference and that tuning and deployment cost a fraction of deploying algorithms with hyperparameters tuned using theoretical results.

title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph: A Geometry and Topology-Aware Multimodal Framework for Cancer Survival Prediction
authors: Noaman Khan, Zubair Shah
abstract:
We developed TopoHyperClinicalGraph, a multimodal framework combining hyperbolic tissue geometry, persistent topology and clinical graph learning for cancer survival prediction. Pre-extracted UNI2-h features are reduced from 1,536 to 1,024 dimensions using training-fold PCA. A pathology backbone combines hyperbolic neighborhoods with Lorentz-centroid attention pooling. Once frozen, its survival logits are adjusted using persistence descriptors from up to 64 landmarks per slide and sampling controls. A five-node clinical graph then learns a further correction from age, sex, stage, T and N.
  Five-fold patient-level evaluation covered eight TCGA and CPTAC cohorts with 2,364 patients. Mean validation-selected C-indices for TopoHyperClinicalGraph versus pathology-only spatial PatchGCN were 0.7563 versus 0.7386 in COADREAD, 0.6220 versus 0.5998 in HNSC, 0.6755 versus 0.6535 in BRCA and 0.6409 versus 0.6176 in STAD. CPTAC scores were 0.5984 in HNSC, 0.6060 in PDA, 0.8055 in CCRCC and 0.7192 in LUAD. CPTAC-HNSC used TCGA-initialized adaptation; other CPTAC backbones were trained within their cohorts. Geometry accounted for most pathology-only gains, with smaller persistence effects. Clinical graph fusion exceeded its matched node-wise control in five cohorts, tied in one and scored lower in two; clinical-only prediction exceeded fusion in three CPTAC cohorts.
  The framework supports separate evaluation of geometric, topological and clinical contributions. All scores were validation-selected; independent testing is needed to establish generalizability.
zh_title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph：一种用于癌症生存预测的几何与拓扑感知多模态框架
translation: 我们开发了TopoHyperClinicalGraph，这是一个结合双曲组织几何、持续拓扑和临床图学习的多模态框架，用于癌症生存预测。预先提取的UNI2-h特征在训练折中通过PCA从1536维降至1024维。病理主干网络结合了双曲邻域与洛伦兹质心注意力池化。该主干网络冻结后，其生存logits会利用每张切片最多64个标志物和采样对照提取的持续拓扑描述符进行调整。随后，一个五节点的临床图进一步根据年龄、性别、分期、T分期和N分期学习修正值。在涵盖8个TCGA和CPTAC队列、共2364名患者的五折患者级别评估中，TopoHyperClinicalGraph对比仅使用病理的空间PatchGCN，在COADREAD中的平均验证选择C-index为0.7563对0.7386，HNSC为0.6220对0.5998，BRCA为0.6755对0.6535，STAD为0.6409对0.6176。CPTAC在HNSC、PDA、CCRCC和LUAD上的得分分别为0.5984、0.6060、0.8055和0.7192。几何特征占据了病理端大部分收益，拓扑持续性影响较小。临床图融合在5个队列中优于匹配的节点级对照，1个持平，2个较低；在3个CPTAC队列中，单纯临床预测优于融合模型。该框架支持分别评估几何、拓扑和临床的贡献。所有得分均为验证集选择结果；仍需要独立测试来验证其泛化能力。
tldr: 提出了结合双曲组织几何、持续拓扑特征与临床图学习的多模态癌症生存预测框架，在多个癌症队列中取得优于传统病理GCN的预测效果。

title: Group Physical-Layer Authentication and Confidential Beamforming in Non-Terrestrial Networks
authors: Parsa Rajabi, Mohammad Reza Abedi, Paeiz Azmi, Nader Mokari
abstract: Coordinated high-altitude platform station (HAPS) networks need to authenticate group responses and protect private data under shared power constraints. This paper studies joint group physical-layer authentication (PLA) and confidential beamforming using a fresh secret tag superimposed on private data. For received attacks independent of the current tag, we derive exact finite-block expressions for false acceptance and legitimate rejection. These expressions translate authentication error targets into a required tag signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR). We establish a nonzero asymptotic tag-energy floor and analyze residual frequency offset and peak-power restrictions. The legitimate receiver removes the tag by orthogonal projection, which discards one temporal dimension. For colluding eavesdroppers, we identify the spatial coverage condition under which artificial noise (AN) keeps their SINR bounded as data and AN powers increase together. We jointly optimize the private beams, tag beam, and AN covariance to minimize transmit power under authentication, secrecy, and per-HAPS power constraints. The method combines semidefinite relaxation (SDR), exact private-beam rank reduction, and feasible successive convex approximation. A corrected dual lower bound measures the remaining optimality gap. Numerical results show that increasing the tag length from 16 to 64 symbols reduces the required tag SINR by 7.16 dB. Joint beam design reduces mean transmit power by 27.4% relative to an optimized fixed-tag-direction baseline. The authentication guarantee requires fresh secret tags and excludes relays of the current response.
zh_title: 非地面网络中的组物理层认证与保密波束成形
translation: 协调式高空平台站（HAPS）网络需要在共享功率约束下对组响应进行认证并保护私有数据。本文研究了使用叠加在私有数据上的新秘密标签的联合组物理层认证（PLA）和保密波束成形。对于独立于当前标签的接收攻击，我们推导了虚假接受和合法拒绝的精确有限块表达式。这些表达式将认证错误目标转化为所需的标签信噪比（SINR）。我们建立了非零渐近标签能量底线，并分析了残余频率偏移和峰值功率限制。合法接收器通过正交投影移除标签，这会丢弃一个时间维度。对于合谋窃听者，我们确定了在数据和人工噪声（AN）功率同时增加时，AN能使窃听者SINR有界的空间覆盖条件。我们联合优化私有波束、标签波束和AN协方差，以在认证、保密和每个HAPS功率约束下最小化发射功率。该方法结合了半正定松弛（SDR）、精确私有波束秩降和可行逐次凸逼近。修正的对偶下界衡量了剩余的最优性差距。数值结果表明，将标签长度从16个符号增加到64个符号，可将所需的标签SINR降低7.16 dB。联合波束设计相对于优化的固定标签方向基线，将平均发射功率降低了27.4%。认证保证需要新的秘密标签，并排除当前响应的中继。
tldr: 本文研究了非地面网络中HAPS的组物理层认证与保密波束成形，通过叠加秘密标签和人工噪声，联合优化波束以最小化发射功率，同时满足认证、保密和功率约束，并取得了显著的功率节省。

title: PDE-Residual-Informed Kriging
authors: Yu Tan, Shichang Du, Yongxiang Li
abstract: Physics-informed Gaussian process (GP) methods provide a probabilistic framework for PDE solving. Existing approaches incorporate PDE information in different ways: pointwise conditioning uses the governing equation only at finitely many selected locations, globally constrained GPs restrict the admissible functions to satisfy the PDE exactly, and residual-penalized methods control the PDE mismatch over the whole domain through an additional penalty weight. What is still missing is a GP formulation that directly incorporates global PDE-residual information of the entire domain into its covariance structure, while retaining model flexibility and standard GP conditioning without a separate residual-weight parameter. To solve this issue, this study proposes PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK) based on a PDE-residual kernel. The PDE-residual kernel is constructed by equipping a kernel-section space with an inner product defined by the $L^{2}$ inner product of PDE residuals. This construction makes PRIK yield the posterior mean with minimum integrated squared PDE residual. It also provides direct statistical interpretations: the variance-scale estimate equals the normalized PDE-residual energy (i.e., the integrated squared PDE residual of the posterior mean divided by the number of labeled observations), and the profile likelihood balances this residual energy against model complexity. Under the stated regularity and stability conditions, we establish $H^{2}$-quasi-optimality and convergence rates for the posterior mean, together with a nonasymptotic bound for its PDE-residual norm. We further show that the normalized posterior kernel converges to a variational Green-type kernel and derive a uniform nonasymptotic contraction bound for the posterior variance. Numerical studies provide empirical evidence consistent with the theory and demonstrate the PDE-solving capability of PRIK.
translation: 物理信息高斯过程（GP）方法为求解偏微分方程（PDE）提供了一个概率框架。现有方法以不同方式整合PDE信息：逐点条件化仅在有限个选定位置使用控制方程，全局约束GP限制容许函数精确满足PDE，而残差惩罚法则通过额外的惩罚权重来控制整个域上的PDE失配。目前所缺少的是一种GP公式，它能够将整个域的全局PDE残差信息直接纳入其协方差结构中，同时保持模型的灵活性和标准GP条件化，而无需单独的残差权重参数。为了解决这个问题，本研究提出了基于PDE残差核的PDE残差信息克里金法（PRIK）。PDE残差核是通过为核截面空间配备由PDE残差的$L^{2}$内积定义的内积来构建的。这种构建使得PRIK能够产生具有最小积分平方PDE残差的后验均值。它还提供了直接的统计学解释：方差尺度估计等于归一化的PDE残差能量（即后验均值的积分平方PDE残差除以带标签观测值的数量），并且profile似然平衡了该残差能量与模型复杂度。在规定的正则性和稳定性条件下，我们建立了后验均值的$H^{2}$准最优性和收敛速度，以及其PDE残差范数的非渐近界。我们进一步证明了归一化后验核收敛于变分Green型核，并推导出了后验方差的均匀非渐近收缩界。数值研究提供了与理论一致的经验证据，并展示了PRIK的PDE求解能力。
tldr: 本文提出了PRIK方法，通过引入新型PDE残差核，将全局偏微分方程残差直接纳入高斯过程协方差，无需调参即可实现理论保证的高精度PDE求解。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK)方法，将全局偏微分方程残差信息直接融入高斯过程的协方差结构中，无需调节残差惩罚权重，并在理论和数值实验上都展现了优越性。
motivation: 现有的物理信息高斯过程（GP）方法在将PDE信息融入时存在局限：逐点条件化仅在有限位置使用，全局约束限制了解的准确性，而残差惩罚法则需要人为调节惩罚权重。缺少一种能直接将全域全局PDE残差信息纳入协方差结构、保持模型灵活性且无需独立残差权重参数的GP公式。
method: 提出基于PDE残差核的PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK)方法，通过在核截面空间配备由PDE残差的$L^2$内积定义的内积来构建PDE残差核。
results: 理论上建立了后验均值的$H^2$准最优性和收敛速度、PDE残差范数的非渐近界、后验核向变分Green型核的收敛性以及后验方差的均匀非渐近收缩界；数值研究验证了理论并展示了出色的PDE求解能力。
conclusion: 本文提出的PRIK方法成功将全局PDE残差信息融入高斯过程协方差结构，兼具理论保证和良好的数值求解性能。

title: Reliability-Weighted Direct Preference Optimization: Penalized Weights for Robust Preference Learning
authors: Bin Luo, Param Venkat Vivek Kesireddy, Anil Vallepu
abstract:
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats every reported comparison as correct, yet preference data contain
  reversed, tied or otherwise noisy comparisons. RW-DPO gives each comparison an unknown reliability weight
  $w_i\in[0,1]$ that enters the likelihood linearly -- DPO is $w\equiv1$, a reversed comparison $w_i=0$ -- and estimates
  the weights jointly with the policy under a minimax-concave penalty on $-\log w_i$. The penalty keeps every
  comparison the model agrees with at exactly $w_i=1$ and acts only on those it contradicts, through closed-form weight
  updates at negligible cost over DPO. We prove that recovering all flipped comparisons from a single annotation per
  comparison requires margins of order $\log n$. Furthermore, in a linear-index model, starting from an initial fit
  pointing in the correct direction, our estimator jointly consistently recovers the preference direction and weights,
  as well as identifies the flipped comparisons above this margin scale, even when a fixed fraction of comparisons is
  flipped. In simulations RW-DPO has the lowest average estimation error among DPO, noise-rate corrections and recent
  robust methods, with far more precise flags than recent label-correction methods. In DPO fine-tuning of a language
  model with 10-30% flipped labels, its win rate does not fall as the flip rate grows and exceeds that of DPO trained on
  clean labels, matching the strongest recent method with corrections concentrated on the flipped labels.
zh_title: 可靠性加权直接偏好优化：用于鲁棒偏好学习的惩罚权重
translation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）将每个给出的对比样本均视为正确，但偏好数据中往往存在反转、平局或其他噪声对比。RW-DPO为每个对比样本赋予一个未知的可靠性权重 $w_i \in [0,1]$，该权重线性进入似然函数——其中DPO对应于 $w \equiv 1$，完全反转的对比则对应于 $w_i = 0$——并在施加于 $-\log w_i$ 的极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty）下与策略联合估计权重。该惩罚项使得模型赞同的每个对比样本权重严格保持在 $w_i=1$，且仅作用于与模型预测矛盾的样本，同时仅需极小额外计算开销即可通过闭式解更新权重。我们从理论上证明，在每个对比仅有单次标注的情况下，恢复所有反转的对比样本需要 $\log n$ 阶的间隔（margin）。此外，在线性指标模型中，从指向正确方向的初始拟合出发，即使存在固定比例的反转对比，我们的估计器也能联合一致地恢复偏好方向与权重，并识别出该间隔尺度以上的反转对比。在模拟实验中，与DPO、噪声率修正法及近期鲁棒方法相比，RW-DPO取得了最低的平均估计误差，且标记精度远高于近期的标签修正方法。在包含10%至30%反转标签的语言模型DPO微调中，其胜率不仅未随反转率增加而下降，甚至超过了在干净标签上训练的DPO，比肩最优秀的近期方法，并将修正精准集中在反转标签上。
tldr: RW-DPO通过对偏好样本引入可靠性权重与非凸惩罚项，以极小计算开销实现对噪声和反转标签的自适应过滤，显著提升偏好微调的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: RW-DPO巧妙地结合了统计学中的极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty）与DPO目标函数，不仅在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下实现了权重的闭式更新，还提供了在单次标注设置下恢复反转标签的理论边界。该方法在噪声偏好微调场景下展现出极强的鲁棒性，甚至胜过纯净数据训练的标准DPO。
motivation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）默认所有标注的比较样本都是正确的，但现实偏好数据中常含有反转、平局或其他噪声比较，严重影响策略微调性能。
method: 提出了RW-DPO方法：为每个偏好对比样本赋予未知可靠性权重$w_i \in [0, 1]$并线性代入似然函数，同时在$-\log w_i$上施加极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty），从而与策略联合优化；该惩罚对模型认同的样本保持$w_i=1$，仅对冲突样本通过闭式解更新权重，计算开销可忽略不计。
results: 理论上证明了在单次标注下单样本反转恢复所需的间隔阶数为$\log n$，并在线性指标模型中证明了联合一致恢复性；仿真中其估计误差在同类方法中最低；在10-30%标签反转的语言模型微调实验中，RW-DPO的胜率未随反转率上升而下降，甚至超越了在纯净数据上训练的DPO。
conclusion: RW-DPO通过引入可靠性权重惩罚机制，在理论和实证上均证明了其能够有效纠正和过滤噪声/反转偏好对，显著提升了偏好学习的鲁棒性。

title: Underdamped Stochastic Optimal Transport with Landauer boundary conditions: machine learning and analytical solution
authors: Julia Sanders, Dario Lucente, Marco Baldovin, Paolo Muratore-Ginanneschi
abstract: Finding optimal transport protocols for underdamped stochastic processes is a difficult yet important problem in control theory. In this paper we develop a direct method, based on machine learning, to find the optimal solution of the problem in the presence of non-linear boundary conditions, including those modelling the Landauer bit-erasure problem. The dynamics is steered from a single-peak to a double-peak distribution in position space, by only acting on a controllable external potential. The problem is highly non-linear, and analytical solutions are not available in general. We benchmark our numerical results with a perturbative expansion, which is expected to hold in a suitable overdamped limit.
comment: Main: 12 pages, 6 figures. Supplemental material: 11 pages
zh_title: 具有朗道尔边界条件的欠阻尼随机最优输运：机器学习与解析解
translation: 寻找欠阻尼随机过程的最优输运协议是控制理论中一个困难但重要的问题。在本文中，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于在存在非线性边界条件（包括模拟朗道尔比特擦除问题的边界条件）时寻找该问题的最优解。仅通过作用于可控的外加势，动力学在位置空间中从单峰分布被引导至双峰分布。该问题具有高度非线性，通常无法获得解析解。我们使用微扰展开对数值结果进行了基准测试，该微扰展开预计在合适的过阻尼极限下成立。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于解决具有朗道尔非线性边界条件的高非线性欠阻尼随机最优输运问题，并通过微扰展开进行了基准验证。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将机器学习直接方法引入欠阻尼随机最优输运问题中，有效应对了朗道尔比特擦除等复杂的非线性边界条件，并通过过阻尼极限下的微扰展开进行基准验证，在非平衡统计物理与现代控制理论的结合上具有重要价值。
motivation: 欠阻尼随机过程的最优输运协议求解是控制理论中的重要难题，尤其在存在非线性边界条件（如朗道尔比特擦除）时问题高度非线性，通常缺乏解析解。
method: 开发了一种基于机器学习的直接求解方法，仅通过调节可控外势将系统在位置空间中从单峰分布引导至双峰分布，并利用过阻尼极限下的微扰展开法进行基准比对。
results: 成功获得了非线性边界条件下欠阻尼随机最优输运的数值解，并利用合适过阻尼极限下的微扰展开基准对其进行了有效验证。

title: On reduced SPDE models for stochastic Cucker-Smale flocking dynamics
authors: Kamran Arora, Federico Cornalba, Ana Djurdjevac
abstract: Flocking refers to a phenomenon in collective motion where particles align their velocities with each other, commonly modelled using Cucker-Smale dynamics. In this work, we introduce and analyse two general reduced SPDE models for stochastic Cucker-Smale particle dynamics that encompass environmental and i.i.d.-type noises. Our models are computationally cheaper alternatives to the underlying particle system and preserve the flocking behaviour. To derive our reduced models, we consider suitable empirical particle densities which depend on position and time, but feature velocity dependency in a multiplicative fashion: this setup crucially allows for a very intuitive and convenient notion of flocking at the SPDE level. In $d=1$ we prove flocking of the reduced SPDE models, and, for the environmental noise, we also quantify the discrepancy between the reduced SPDE and mollified particle system. We also discuss the technical modifications required to extend the results to higher dimensions. We then provide extensive numerical experiments to verify our theoretical results in $d=1$ and to explore the behaviour of our models in $d=2$.
zh_title: 关于随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维SPDE模型
translation: 群集是指集体运动中的一种现象，其中粒子的速度相互对齐，通常使用Cucker-Smale动力学来建模。在这项工作中，我们引入并分析了两个通用的降维SPDE模型，用于描述包含环境噪声和独立同分布（i.i.d.）噪声的随机Cucker-Smale粒子动力学。我们的模型是底层粒子系统的计算成本更低的替代方案，并且能够保持群集行为。为了推导出我们的降维模型，我们考虑了适当的经验粒子密度，这些密度取决于位置和时间，但以乘法方式表现出速度依赖性：这种设置至关重要地允许在SPDE层面上对群集进行非常直观和方便的概念化。在 $d=1$ 维度下，我们证明了降维SPDE模型的群集性，对于环境噪声，我们还量化了降维SPDE与平滑粒子系统之间的差异。我们还讨论了将结果扩展到更高维度所需的技术修改。随后，我们提供了大量的数值实验，以验证我们在 $d=1$ 下的理论结果，并探讨了我们的模型在 $d=2$ 下的行为。
tldr: 本文提出了随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维SPDE模型，既能降低计算成本又能保持群集行为，并通过理论证明和数值实验进行了验证。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地提出了适用于随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维随机偏微分方程（SPDE）模型，不仅在计算上更具优势，而且在SPDE层面上保持了群集行为，并通过数学证明和数值实验进行了严格验证。
motivation: 传统的随机Cucker-Smale粒子系统在计算上成本高昂，因此需要开发计算成本更低、同时能保持群集行为的降维SPDE模型。
method: 考虑依赖于位置和时间、且速度依赖性呈乘法关系的经验粒子密度，从而推导出两个通用的降维SPDE模型；在一维情况下证明了群集行为并量化了误差，同时讨论了高维扩展的技术修改并进行了数值实验。
results: 在一维情况下证明了降维SPDE模型的群集性，量化了环境噪声下降维SPDE与平滑粒子系统之间的差异，并经一维和二维的广泛数值实验验证了理论结果。
conclusion: 本文成功导出了随机Cucker-Smale动力学的降维SPDE模型，在数学上证明了一维情况下的群集行为及误差界，并通过高维数值实验验证了模型的有效性。

title: Distributed Zeroth-Order Composite Finite-Sum Optimization via Incremental Variance Reduction
authors: Silan Zhang, Yujie Tang
abstract: We study decentralized composite finite-sum optimization over a fixed connected undirected network, where agents access local component functions through function evaluations and share a possibly nonsmooth convex regularizer. In this setting, standard two-point gradient estimators can retain nonvanishing variance at a solution, complicating their integration with gradient tracking. We propose Distributed Zeroth-Order Incremental Variance Reduction (Distributed ZIVR), which combines incrementally updated component-gradient estimates with a proximal gradient-tracking scheme. The method admits an implementation using a constant number of function evaluations per agent at every iteration, without intermittent full-component or full-coordinate refreshes. For convex smooth component functions and strongly convex local averages, we establish linear convergence up to a controllable finite-difference error. With the finite-difference radius chosen for the target accuracy, Chebyshev-accelerated mixing yields a per-agent oracle complexity of $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$ for expected squared solution error $ε$, where $d$ is the dimension, $m$ is the number of components per agent, and $κ$ is the condition number. This matches the centralized ZIVR oracle bound, while the communication bound has only an inverse square-root dependence on the network spectral gap. Experiments on logistic and robust regression demonstrate rapid reduction of solution and consensus errors.
zh_title: 基于增量方差约简的分布式零阶复合有限和优化
translation: 我们研究了固定连通无向网络上的分散式复合有限和优化问题，其中智能体通过函数评估访问局部组件函数，并共享一个可能非光滑的凸正则化器。在此设置下，标准的两点梯度估计器在解处可能保留非零方差，这使其与梯度追踪的集成变得复杂。我们提出了分布式零阶增量方差指数约简（Distributed ZIVR），它将增量更新的分量梯度估计与近端梯度追踪方案结合起来。该方法在每次迭代中每个智能体只需使用常数个函数评估，无需间断的全组件或全坐标刷新。对于凸平滑分量函数和强凸局部平均，我们建立了一个可控有限差分误差范围内的线性收敛性。当为目标精度选择有限差分半径时，Chebyshev加速混合产生了 $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$ 的每个智能体预言机复杂度（对应于期望平方解误差 $\varepsilon$），其中 $d$ 是维度，$m$ 是每个智能体的组件数，$k$ 是条件数。这与集中式ZIVR的预言机界相匹配，而通信界对网络谱隙只有逆平方根依赖。逻辑回归和鲁棒回归的实验证明了解误差和共识误差的快速降低。
tldr: 提出了一种新的分布式零阶优化算法（Distributed ZIVR），通过增量方差约简实现了与集中式算法相匹配的预言机复杂度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种分布式零阶组合有限和优化算法，通过结合增量方差约简与近端梯度追踪技术，在保证较低函数评估次数的同时实现了线性收敛，并在理论上匹配了集中式算法的预言机复杂度，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。
motivation: 在分散式复合有限和优化中，标准的两点梯度估计在解处会保留非零方差，从而使其与梯度追踪的集成变得复杂，因此需要一种新的零阶优化方法来解决这一问题。
method: 提出分布式零阶增量方差约简算法（Distributed ZIVR），结合了增量更新的分量梯度估计与近端梯度追踪方案，利用Chebyshev加速混合。
results: 对于凸平滑分量函数和强凸局部平均，建立了达到可控有限差分误差的线性收敛性；在目标精度下，每个智能体的预言机复杂度达到 $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$，匹配了集中式ZIVR的预言机界。
conclusion: 本文提出的Distributed ZIVR算法在分布式零阶组合有限和优化问题上取得了突破，实现了与集中式算法相匹配的预言机复杂度，并通过实验验证了其有效性。

title: Enhancing Medical Lesion Segmentation via Several Simple Modules
authors: Ruichen Li, Zhao Yao
abstract: This work introduces three lightweight enhancement modules for medical lesion segmentation to improve clinical applicability, particularly under data-scarce and computationally constrained environments. Current mainstream methods struggle with the lack of high-quality annotations for rare pathologies, which often leads to severe morphological distortions during inference, despite achieving seemingly ideal DSC scores. Furthermore, the isolated development of individual segmentation tasks restricts cross-domain methodological innovation, underscoring the need for leveraging shared knowledge across different lesions within the same anatomical region. However, constrained access to historical data and annotations hinders efficient knowledge extraction and triggers catastrophic forgetting when adapting to new classes. To address these challenges, we first propose DT-Morph Combined Loss with continuous spatial pooling to optimize differentiable topological structures and boundary continuity. Second, we introduce 3D Group Prompt, which extracts domain-universal knowledge via curated volumetric image-mask alignment prompts together with text prompts built on SAT baseline. Finally, we replace conventional output layers with Many-to-One Conditional Segmentation Head equipped with synonym-resolved routing, which brings negligible computational cost and enables fast incremental learning for new categories without sacrificing performance on old tasks. Ablation studies on abdominal and extra-abdominal datasets covering both organ and lesion segmentation verify the efficacy of our modules.
zh_title: 通过几个简单的模块增强医学病灶分割
translation: 本研究引入了三个用于医学病灶分割的轻量级增强模块，以提高临床适用性，特别是在数据稀缺和计算受限的环境下。当前的主流方法在缺乏高质量稀有病理注释的情况下，尽管获得了看似理想的DSC分数，但在推理过程中往往会导致严重的形态畸变。此外，各个分割任务的孤立发展限制了跨域方法的创新，这凸显了利用同一解剖区域内不同病灶之间共享知识的必要性。然而，对历史数据和注释的受限访问阻碍了高效的知识提取，并在适应新类别时引发灾难性遗忘。为了解决这些挑战，我们首先提出了结合连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失，以优化可微分拓扑结构和边界连续性。其次，我们引入了3D Group Prompt，通过精心策划的体积图像-掩膜对齐提示以及基于SAT基线构建的文本提示来提取域通用知识。最后，我们用配备同义词解析路由的多对一条件分割头替换了传统的输出层，这带来了微不足道的计算成本，并实现了对新类别的快速增量学习，同时不牺牲对旧任务的性能。在涵盖器官和病灶分割的腹部及腹部外数据集上的消融实验验证了我们模块的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了三个轻量级的增强模块，解决了医学病灶分割中的形态失真、跨域知识迁移困难及灾难性遗忘问题。
ai_comments: 该论文设计了三个轻量级模块来解决医学病灶分割中的数据稀缺、形态失真以及增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，具有很强的临床应用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有主流方法在处理缺乏高质量注释的稀有病理时容易产生形态失真，且在跨任务迁移时面临数据受限和灾难性遗忘的挑战，需要轻量级且高效的模块来提升临床适用性。
method: 1. 提出结合连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失函数；2. 引入利用体图像-掩膜对齐提示和文本提示的3D Group Prompt；3. 使用配备同义词解析路由的多对一条件分割头替代传统输出层。
